$comment: Read by scripts/check-no-network.js. urlPrefixes: URLs that may appear as strings in code because they are shown to the person as links (onboarding install links, the repo) or are JSON-schema identifiers bundled with ajv; none of them is ever fetched. files: repo-relative code files allowed to import a network module (none today; the gate and the hook use only http on 127.0.0.1). knownBenign: specific findings inside bundled dependencies that cannot run in the extension host; every entry needs a reason.

knownBenign.reason: Emscripten loader bundled from @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm: the XHR branches only run under ENVIRONMENT_IS_WEB / ENVIRONMENT_IS_WORKER, never in the Node extension host, and the extension passes the wasm bytes itself.
